query.description:
The search query.

**Operators**

- `site:<domain>`: restrict results to a single domain. For multiple domains, use `include_domains` and `exclude_domains`.
- `-site:<domain>`: exclude a single domain from the results.

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results. The `site:` query operator adds to this list. Applies to `results` only; entity cards do not support domain filtering.

exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results. The `-site:` query operator adds to this list. If a domain appears in both `include_domains` and `exclude_domains`, `exclude_domains` takes precedence. Applies to `results` only; entity cards do not support domain filtering.

time_basis.description: Determines which time field is used for time filtering. `published` uses time_published; `crawled` uses time_last_crawled. Results missing this field are excluded when filtering by time. Applies to `results` only; entity cards do not support time filtering.

time_range.description: Relative time window counting back from the current time based on `time_basis`. Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time`: if both are provided, `start_time`/`end_time` take precedence.

start_time.description: Start time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: End time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

language.description: A list of languages to restrict results to, as ISO 639-1 codes.

BusinessEntityOptions.description: Controls the entity cards returned for companies and people.

count.description: Maximum number of entity cards to return.

max_activities.description: Maximum number of recent activities to return per entity card.

FullContentOptions.description: Controls whether to return the full raw content of each result page.

enable.description: If true, returns full_content for each result.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens of full content included per result.

HighlightOptions.description: Controls highlight extraction from result pages.

enable.description: If true, returns query-relevant highlight in each result.
